original.description: The requisition of motor cars on the Esplanade des Invalides, Paris, 5 August 1914 — the Commons record reads "Réquisition des automobiles sur l’Esplanade des Invalides, Paris le 5 août 1914."
original.photographer: Agence Rol (press agency; the operator is not named)
original.archive: Bibliothèque nationale de France, Agence Rol collection; digitised on Gallica, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; UsageTerms "Public domain"). Credit line on the record: Gallica Digital Library.

colorization.status: not colorized. Recommendation: colorize — the Paris taxi livery (red body, black wings) is documented and is exactly what makes the taxis card land.

content_policy: ok — cars parked on an esplanade, no gore
caption: Motor cars requisitioned on the Esplanade des Invalides, Paris, 5 August 1914 — a month before six hundred of the city’s taxis carried part of the 7th Division to the Ourcq.
credit: Original photograph: Agence Rol, Paris, 5 August 1914; Bibliothèque nationale de France, via Gallica and Wikimedia Commons; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. The best-attested period photograph found for the motor-transport card: it is the requisition itself, five weeks before the Marne, not a re-captioned museum exhibit. The Commons record gives no Rol reference number — trace the Gallica ark before this goes to print (sand-y0u.7).
